verdict.rationale: The pack shows public GitHub repositories for Braintrust's JavaScript SDK and OpenAPI spec, but none of the evidence names an open-source license for any code. The core platform is not shown as open source: even in self-hosting, Braintrust says it provides the managed UI, authentication and platform updates. Code examples from an SDK repo do not show that the product's source is readable under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
